title: Enter the network
lead: Use your IDN digital identity or receive a one-time code.
configurationUnavailable: Sign-in methods are unavailable. Reload this page to try again.
signOutIncomplete: Complete sign-out could not be confirmed. Some devices may still be signed in.
idnHelp: IDN verifies your identity. You will choose your own display name in the network.
idnUnavailable: IDN sign-in is not yet available. You can use a one-time code.
phoneHint: Use the international format, including + and the country code.
codeHint: The code is valid for five minutes and can only be used once.
cooldown: Wait {{count}} seconds before requesting another code for these contact details.
resent: A new code was sent. Use the most recent one.
localCodeHint: This code is displayed only in local development.

idnReturn.refused: You did not authorise sign-in with IDN. You can start again whenever you like.
idnReturn.unavailable: IDN is not responding right now. Try again in a few moments.
idnReturn.accountExists: An account opened with a code already uses this email address. Sign in to that account, then link your IDN identity from its settings.
idnReturn.failed: Sign-in with IDN did not complete. You can start again.

errors.invalidPhone: Enter a phone number in international format, with + followed by the country code and number.
errors.codeFormat: Enter all six digits of the code.
errors.invalidCode: This code does not match. Check all six digits.
errors.expiredCode: This code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
errors.deliveryUnavailable: Code delivery is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.network: The service is not responding. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Sign-in did not complete. Try again.
